title: 'See you there': After CJP, AISA's Neha Bora extends support to INDIA bloc's Nov 1 anti-CEC protest at Ramlila Maidan

ai.summary: Student activist Neha Bora of AISA extended support for INDIA bloc's November 1 protest against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in voter roll revision. The rally aims to demand CEC resignation, halt the SIR exercise, and withdraw the 2023 law.

facts.claim: Neha Bora urged citizens to reach Ramlila Maidan on November 1 to protect voting rights and uphold democracy
facts.quote: Neha Bora urged the citizens to reach the Ramlila Maidan on November 1 "to protect their voting rights and uphold the sanctity of democracy".

facts.claim: The protest is scheduled for November 1 at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi
facts.quote: The protest is scheduled to be held at the Ramlila Maidan in Delhi on November 1.

facts.claim: The protest demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, a halt to the SIR exercise, and withdrawal of the 2023 law
facts.quote: Our demand to seek Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, impose a complete halt on the SIR exercise, and withdraw the 2023 law will culminate in a movement at Ramlila Maidan on November 1

facts.claim: The INDIA bloc organized a public impeachment of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on October 30, which was postponed to October 31 due to bad weather
facts.quote: INDIA bloc's "public impeachment" of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, scheduled for October 30, was postponed to October 31 due to bad weather.

ai.background_note: The protest targets alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter rolls, a process where the Election Commission rechecks voter lists to ensure accuracy.
